name: Personalized Nutrition Initiative Innovation Day 2026
organizer: Personalized Nutrition Initiative, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
venue: Illini Union, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
description: PN Innovation Day is the Personalized Nutrition Initiative's annual meeting bringing together university researchers and external partners around personalized nutrition research, with a call for abstracts. The 2026 edition runs September 28 to 30, 2026 at the Illini Union, including a clinical research facility tour and welcome dinner, the main programming day, and an external partners program meeting.
